climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, warm summer

climate: Most rain falls while the vines grow. Damp leaves invite mildew and rot, so growers spray more and pick carefully.

blurb.text: A wine area in Niederösterreich (Lower Austria), Austria, whose DAC wines are Grüner Veltliner or Riesling, at least 12 percent alcohol. Grüner Veltliner is fresh and spicy, Riesling has stone fruit and mineral notes, and the regular wines show no botrytis or oak.
